About these figures

  • All figures are from the borough's adopted budgets: what Borough Council planned for each year, not what was actually spent or collected. Each year's figure comes from that year's budget (2016's from the 2017 budget).
  • They cover the budgets' summary of all operating funds: the General Fund, the Sewer & Solid Waste Fund, and the Liquid Fuels (highway) Fund.
